description: Record's one window: a header bar across the top, over three columns: the notebooks and the open notebook's pages on the left, tabs (a page of notes, a chat being read, a file's code, Feedback) in the middle, Meta, Files and Git on the right. Window opens 1320 x 860.

parts.name: header bar
parts.shows: Across the whole window, over all three columns. Left to right: the notebooks-column toggle (sidebar icon, tooltip "Notebooks", on while the column shows); the open notebook's name centred (the text's own weight, ends in … past 48 characters, empty with no notebook open); at the right end the right-bar toggle (right-sidebar icon, on while it shows) and the ☰ menu button.

actions.does: Slides the left column away or back. Nothing a side column is dragged over hides the bar.
Slides the right column away or back.
Tooltip "Rename: right-click the notebook in the sidebar, or F2" (only with a notebook open).

parts.name: host-apart banner
parts.shows: A banner just under the header bar, hidden normally. It appears once this machine's host process has been running other code than Record's for a while, with the banner's title and a button that restarts them onto the same code. Same banner Baude has.

actions.does: Restarts Record, or this machine's host process, whichever puts both on the same code.

parts.name: notebooks column
parts.shows: The left column, held at one width (200 at first; its edge is dragged to resize, a notebook or page name too long ends in …). See RecordNotebooks and RecordPages.

actions.does: Resizes the column; the width is kept.

parts.name: middle: tabs
parts.shows: A tab bar at the top of an inner panel, the open tab's content under it. The tabs and the page under them are one rounded island set into the window frame. See RecordTabs. Empty states are below.

actions.does: Back and forward through the tabs shown, as a browser's history; a closed tab is opened again if it can be.
Up: from a sub-page, the page it is under; from a file's code, its folder in Files with the file selected.

decisions.said: Baude's tabs and the chat under them make the middle an island; Record should use that style too
decisions.rule: Every app draws its main tab bar and the page under it as one rounded island set into the window frame.

parts.name: right column
parts.shows: At least 340 wide; a draggable rule between it and the middle (its position is kept). At its top a page switcher centred: Meta (Baude's Meta icon), Files, Git. Under it the chosen page. Code opens in a tab, not here. See RecordMeta for Meta; Files and Git are Baude's pages for the folder of the chat being read.

actions.does: Shows Meta (right column opened if hidden) and puts the focus in its box; if Meta is already showing, closes the right column and puts the focus back where it was (the page's text at the caret, the chat read, the file's code).

parts.name: capture bar
parts.shows: A bar at the foot of the middle while a Send Feedback capture is pending (Baude's own: shared).

states.name: no notebook
states.shows: Middle shows a status page: people icon, title "Make a Notebook", text "A Notebook is your notes on a subject; Meta, in the right bar, reads them and AI prose with you, and organises them." and a pill-shaped suggested button "New Notebook" (makes one, as Ctrl+N). Meta still works (there are tools to add a notebook, open a host).

states.name: notebook open, no tabs
states.shows: Middle is blank, inside the frame.

states.name: Feedback tab without a notebook
states.shows: The Ongoing Feedback tab shows even with no notebook open.

states.name: update waiting

decisions.said: Even with Auto restart on update off, the Update button should always show when a newer version is there, at the foot of the sessions list or of the window (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app looks for a newer version whether or not Auto restart on update is on, and shows Update at the foot of its sessions or notebooks list whenever one is there; with the setting off it never restarts by itself, only when Update is clicked

states.shows: A newer version there, whether or not Auto restart on update is on: an Update button at the foot of the left column, under the notebooks, its tooltip listing what an automatic restart is waiting for ("a question being answered", "a dialog open", "you, using this window"). With the setting on Record restarts itself once idle; on or off, clicking the button restarts now (a spinner on it while the new version is checked). A newer version that can't be restarted onto says why in place of the button, as Baude's does. When a question is being answered to Meta, the click first asks "Restart now?" (body "The question being answered is stopped.", buttons Cancel, Restart Now in red).

states.name: daemon restart pending

decisions.said: When the daemon is waiting to restart, the owner wants to see which chats, tasks or services are holding it up; while that view is open the restart is paused, with Restart and Force Restart buttons (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app shows a host's pending daemon restart (a toast with Details: Sidebar's "Daemon restart toast"); Details lists what the restart waits for (each chat running a command, each task running) and the restart is paused while that view is open. Restart (or closing it) restarts once nothing is running; Force Restart restarts now. The host keeps the pending restart and its blockers and says them on the wire (info's restart), so every app shows the same

decisions.said: can I click it to go to the thread? There should be a "See Thread" button
decisions.rule: Every app's "Waiting For" gives each row a See Thread button: a chat (or the chat elsewhere an agent run is for) opens that chat, a running task opens its run page, an attached terminal opens that terminal. The restart stays paused while the person looks: its toast is back reading "Daemon restart paused", and its Details brings back Restart and Force Restart

decisions.said: The restart also waits for agent runs this host does for other hosts' chats and for host terminals someone is attached to, not for Multiplex, Emission or Auto-fix, which survive a daemon restart; closing Waiting For resumes the restart (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every host waits for, and every app lists, chats running a command, task runs, agent runs for chats on other hosts (Apple and pi models) and attached host terminals; closing "Waiting For" without a button lets go of the pause, so the restart goes on

decisions.said: The pending daemon restart's line shouldn't sit in the bar where Update is: the toast it was before was fine, it only needed a button to open what the restart waits for. Not sure "Waiting For" updates as things finish, or stays stuck with the first ones (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app says a host's pending daemon restart as a toast (the phone's snackbar), never in the Update bar, which keeps only Update. The toast says what the restart waits for, kept up as that changes, with Details, which opens "Waiting For" (the restart paused while it's open). It's shown once per pending restart, in the window in front, and goes as toasts do (10 s, or dismissed): the restart goes on, as after Restart. After See Thread the toast is back, "Daemon restart paused", till it's dismissed (that pause let go of) or Details is clicked. "Waiting For" and the toast are drawn again as the host says what the restart waits for (the host looks every 500 ms and pushes its info when that changes), so a chat's command or a task's run ending takes its row away and the count down

states.shows: A toast over the window, one per host keeping a daemon restart (This Mac's first, each named "<host>: …" when there's more than one): "Restarting the daemon once N things are done", kept up as that changes, or "Daemon restart paused" while any app shows what it waits for or a See Thread from it is being looked at; Details opens the same "Waiting For" dialog as Baude's, with See Thread on each row (a chat read in a tab of its own; a terminal in ☰ → Terminal), Restart and Force Restart. Nothing at the foot of the left column but Update.

states.name: restarted
states.shows: After ☰ → Restart Record or an auto-update the window comes back as it was: the notebook, the tab, window size and place, right column width and page, what was typed in Meta's box with its caret and quote, the page's caret and an un-kept new title, and every open page, chat and Meta's own scroll position. A toast says it updated ("Record updated", with the count of new commits).

removed.name: Daemon restart line at the foot of the list, over Update
removed.why: The owner: the pending restart shouldn't sit in the bar where Update is; the toast was fine, it only needed a button to open "Waiting For" (paraphrased)

removed.name: Attached folders (the right bar's Folders page, Attach / Detach, Detach all)
removed.why: The owner: no longer needed; what they fed comes from the folder of the chat being read
